title: Code Analysis Channel Descriptor
description: Schema for declaring analysis channel metadata. Used by built-in scanners and extensions alike.

channel.description: Unique channel identifier (e.g., codeql, ruff, ext-my-scanner)

tool.description: Human-readable tool name (e.g., CodeQL, Ruff, My Custom Scanner)

class.description: Functional class for grouping and UI presentation

surface.description: Analysis surface area (e.g., semantic-sast, python-quality, dependency)

workflow.description: Workflow file that produces this channel evidence

artifact_patterns.description: Glob patterns for discovering this channel evidence artifacts

scanner_family.description: Scanner family name for grouping (defaults to tool if omitted)

mode.description: Execution mode: source runs against checked-out source, vendor calls external API

adapter.description: Path to trusted adapter script (required for extensions, optional for built-ins with standard SARIF/JSON output)

secrets.description: Environment variable to secret name mappings (vendor mode only)

deferred_reason.description: Reason for deferral if this channel is not currently enabled

sensitive.description: Whether findings may contain sensitive data that should be redacted in reports

groups.description: Logical groups this channel belongs to for joint enablement (e.g., python-quality, security-sast)

portable.description: Whether this channel is available in portable mode

languages.description: Programming languages this channel applies to

requires_docker.description: Whether this channel requires Docker to run
